title: The Most Intolerant Wins: The Dominance of the Stubborn Minority
coreMove: Separate head-count power from tolerance asymmetry, then look for the local threshold where the strict preference becomes the whole system default.
sourcePressure: A tiny intransigent minority can set a default for everyone when the majority is flexible enough to accept the stricter option.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating the lesson as simple praise for stubbornness or as a majority-versus-minority politics slogan.

sourceAnchors.name: kosher lemonade
sourceAnchors.detail: The source uses kosher drinks to show how a strict minority can set a production default that non-kosher consumers can also accept.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The small kosher mark on a bottle is the quiet evidence: the stricter rule wins because the looser side can drink it too.
